recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的中至大型淋巴細胞，細胞質深藍並含清楚的小空泡、核不規則有核仁；流式為 CD19+/CD10+ kappa 限制，FISH 顯示 IGH::MYC 雙融合與 BCL6 斷裂，另有 11q 異常，符合 MYC/BCL6 高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤的白血病期。
features: PB smear (A-C): medium to large lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and one or more visible nucleoli
Flow (D): CD19+ CD20+ CD10+ population with kappa light chain restriction, CD4-
Karyotype (E): complex karyotype with arrows marking abnormal chromosomes 3, 8, 11 and 14 (t(8;14))
FISH: MYC/IGH double fusion (F), BCL6 break-apart split signal (G), 11q triple-color probe showing 11q23 gain/11q24 loss (H)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing punched-out vacuoles, round to irregular nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, and visible nucleoli. Flow cytometry identifies a CD19-, CD20- and CD10-positive B-cell population with kappa light chain restriction. The karyotype is complex with t(8;14)(q24;q32), and FISH confirms IGH::MYC fusion, BCL6 rearrangement, and an 11q23 gain/11q24 loss pattern, without BCL2 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with leukemic high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL6 rearrangements and concurrent 11q aberration.

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma shares vacuolated basophilic cells and IG::MYC, but typically has a simple karyotype without BCL6 rearrangement or complex abnormalities, in a younger patient.
This entity shows the 11q23 gain/11q24 loss pattern by definition without MYC rearrangement, whereas IGH::MYC fusion is present here.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Distinguished only by FISH: BCL2 rearrangement is absent in this case.
B-ALL blasts are TdT+ and usually CD34+ with surface light chain negativity, whereas these cells are mature kappa-restricted B cells.
